# Me (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Me` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 9 actions on 3 resources, 4 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-me) | `GET /me` |
| [GET](#get-me-addresses) | `GET /me/addresses?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Type={Type}&DefaultForType={DefaultForType}&Country={Country}&StateProvince={StateProvince}&CitySuburb={CitySuburb}` |
| [POST](#post-me-addresses) | `POST /me/addresses` |
| [PUT](#put-me-addresses) | `PUT /me/addresses` |
| [DELETE](#delete-me-addresses) | `DELETE /me/addresses?ID={ID}` |
| [GET](#get-me-contacts) | `GET /me/contacts?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&Type={Type}&DefaultForType={DefaultForType}&Phone={Phone}&Fax={Fax}&Email={Email}` |
| [POST](#post-me-contacts) | `POST /me/contacts` |
| [PUT](#put-me-contacts) | `PUT /me/contacts` |
| [DELETE](#delete-me-contacts) | `DELETE /me/contacts?ID={ID}` |


## Me

Path: `/me`

### Available Fields for ME
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `Company`  | String           |         |          |Your company name          |
| `Currency`  | String             |         |          |Your company base currency          |
| `TimeZone`  | String             |         |          |Time Zone where your company located          |
| `DefaultWeightUnits`  | String             | 10        |          |Unit of measure for unit weight. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
| `DefaultDimensionsUnits`  | String             | 10        |      |Unit of measure for unit length/width/height. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
| `LockDate`  | Date             |         |          |Financial settings option. Indicates date period start from what you can change transactional data. Formatted in Tenant date format          |
| `OpeningBalanceDate`  | Date             |         |          |Date of opening balances in the system. Formatted in Tenant date format          |
| `TaxCalculationMethod`  | String             |         | Row Total, Total    |Indicate if tax calculation should be based on Row total or (Document) Total          |
| `DefaultSaleTaxRuleId`  | Guid             |         |          |Taxation rule ID selected by default when creating new customers          |
| `DefaultSaleTaxRuleName`  | String             |         |          |Taxation rule Name selected by default when creating new customers          |
| `MaximumDecimalPlacesInQuantity`  | String             |         |          |Maximum decimal places in quantity on printable documents         |
| `ApplyCustomerDiscountsAfterOtherDiscounts`  | Bool             |         |          |In some scenarios, the seller wants to add an extra discount to the selected customers despite the fact that product related discounts are already applied         |
| `DiscountRule`  | String             |         | Discount, Price      | This will let the system process any available discount by either amending the sale price of the item or recalculating the discount % in the sale order line for the eligible item    |
| `AutomaticallyApplyDiscounts`  | Bool             |         |          |Enable this option to allow Cin7 Core to automatically apply discounts and deals on authorisation         |
|`RoundingTable`|<a href="#RoundingTableModel"><b>[] Rounding Table Model</b></a>|||The calculated price will be rounded to the specified value and adjusted as per specified rule to let you implement your special price ending/charm pricing strategy|

### Available Fields for Rounding Table Model <a id="RoundingTableModel"></a>
| Property          | Type      | Length| Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `RangeTo`              | Decimal      |       |       |                       |
| `RoundToNearest`     | Decimal      |       | |                         |
| `AdjustmentRule`        | String        |           | N, S, A     | No Ajustment (N), Add (A), Subtract (S)                      |
| `AdjustmentValue`        | String        |           |      |                       |

## Me Address

Path: `/me/addresses`

### Available Fields for Me Address
| Property          | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `AddressID`       | Guid      |           |           | Unique Address ID.    |
| `Line1`           | String    | 256       | Yes       | Address Line 1.       |
| `Line2`           | String    | 256       |           | Address Line 2.       |
| `CitySuburb`      | String    | 256       | Yes       | City / Suburb.        |
| `StateProvince`   | String    | 256       | Yes       | State / Province.     |
| `ZipPostCode`     | String    | 20        | Yes       | Zip / PostCode.       |
| `Country`         | String    |           | Yes       | Country name          |
| `Type`            | String    |           | Yes       | Address Type.  Should be one of the following values: `Billing`, `Business` or `Shipping`. |
| `DefaultForType`  | Bool      |           |           | Points that Address is used as default for chosen Type. `False` as default. |

<a id="get-me-addresses"></a>
### GET /me/addresses?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Type={Type}&DefaultForType={DefaultForType}&Country={Country}&StateProvince={StateProvince}&CitySuburb={CitySuburb}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return MeAddress with the specific ID
- `Type` (optional, string): Only return MeAddresses with the specific Type
- `DefaultForType` (optional, bool): Only return MeAddresses which are marked as default for chosen Type
- `Country` (optional, string): Only return MeAddresses with the specific Country
- `StateProvince` (optional, string): Only return MeAddresses with the specific StateProvince
- `CitySuburb` (optional, string): Only return MeAddresses with the specific CitySuburb

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 2,
  "Page": 1,
  "MeAddressesList": [
    {
      "AddressID": "d8309201-3498-47a2-99cd-b14786e0753b",
      "Line1": "DEFAULT billing address",
      "Line2": null,
      "CitySuburb": "DEFAULT City",
      "StateProvince": "DEFAULT State",
      "ZipPostCode": "DEFAULT Postcode",
      "Country": "Australia",
      "Type": "Billing",
      "DefaultForType": true
    },
    {
      "AddressID": "94147b9b-9320-4320-95c3-effe4c3ef5f5",
      "Line1": "DEFAULT shipping address",
      "Line2": null,
      "CitySuburb": "DEFAULT City",
      "StateProvince": "DEFAULT State",
      "ZipPostCode": "DEFAULT Postcode",
      "Country": "Australia",
      "Type": "Shipping",
      "DefaultForType": true
    }
  ]
}
```

## Me Contact

Path: `/me/contacts`

### Available Fields for Me Contact
| Property          | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `ContactID`       | Guid      |           |           | Unique MeContact ID.  |
| `Name`            | String    | 256       | Yes       | Name of MeContact.    |
| `Phone`           | String    | 50        |           | Phone                 |
| `Fax`             | String    | 50        |           | Fax                   |
| `Email`           | String    | 256       |           | Email                 |
| `Website`         | String    | 256       |           | Website               |
| `Comment`         | String    | 256       |           | Comment               |
| `Type`            | String    | 50        |           | MeContact Type. Should be one of the following values: `Billing`, `Business`, `Sale`, `Shipping` or `Employee`. |
| `DefaultForType`  | Bool      |           |           | Points that MeContact is used as default for chosen Type. `False` as default. |

<a id="get-me-contacts"></a>
### GET /me/contacts?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&Type={Type}&DefaultForType={DefaultForType}&Phone={Phone}&Fax={Fax}&Email={Email}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return MeContact with the specific ID
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return MeContact that start with the specific Name
- `Type` (optional, string): Only return MeContact with the specific Type
- `DefaultForType` (optional, bool): Only return MeContact which are marked as default for chosen Type
- `Phone` (optional, string): Only return MeContact with the specific Phone
- `Fax` (optional, string): Only return MeContact with the specific Fax
- `Email` (optional, string): Only return MeContact with the specific Email

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 2,
  "Page": 1,
  "MeContactsList": [
    {
```
